# pip constraints for the manylinux2014 build/test containers.
#
# The manylinux2014 image ships devtoolset-10 (gcc 10.2.1). numpy 2.5.0 raised
# its build requirement to "GCC >= 10.3", so any numpy >= 2.5 that has to be
# built from source in this image fails during metadata generation:
#
#     ../meson.build:25:4: ERROR: Problem encountered: NumPy requires GCC >= 10.3
#
# Source builds are unavoidable for some ABIs: numpy publishes manylinux2014
# wheels only up to 2.2.6 (cp310-cp313), and none at all for cp314, whose Linux
# wheels are manylinux_2_28 only. Capping below 2.5 keeps the sdist fallback
# buildable, while PIP_PREFER_BINARY still picks the 2.2.6 wheel where one
# exists.
#
# Remove this once the base image moves to manylinux_2_28 (gcc 12+), which has
# wheels for every ABI we build.
numpy<2.5
